# ImqPlugin.plugins property

The two halves this integration is composed of, which is what makes `{ client: false }` and `{ server: false }` valid options.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static get plugins(): {
        client: typeof ImqClientPlugin;
        server: typeof ImqServerPlugin;
    };
```
